# Output engines

> **Audience:** deck authors, agents and contributors · **Generated from:** src/backends/*.ts · **Version:** 0.7.7

Every engine renders the same Scene IR, so layouts look the same in every output. Choose with `output.engines` in deck.yaml, `--pptx-engine` / `--pdf-engine`, or let `auto` decide. See [choose an output engine](../how-to/choose-output-engine.md) for recommendations and [engines compared](../explanation/engines-compared.md) for pros and cons.

| Kind | Engine | What | Editable | Native charts | Notes | Fidelity | Install | License | CI |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pptx | `pptxgenjs` | Editable PowerPoint (pptxgenjs) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | native | bundled | MIT | ✅ |
| pdf | `native` | Native vector PDF (pdfkit) | — | — | — | same-layout | bundled | MIT | ✅ |
| png | `resvg` | PNG previews (resvg) | — | — | — | preview | bundled (wasm) | MPL-2.0 (resvg), MIT (SlideCraft) | ✅ |
| onepager | `onepager` | One-page summary PDF (pdfkit) | — | — | — | same-layout | bundled | MIT | ✅ |
| docx | `docx` | Word memo (DOCX) | ✅ | — | ✅ | preview | bundled | MIT | ✅ |
| html | `html` | Self-contained HTML deck | — | — | ✅ | same-layout | bundled | MIT | ✅ |
| pdf | `html` | PDF via system Chrome (HTML print) | — | — | — | same-layout | system Chrome or Chromium | MIT (SlideCraft); uses your installed Chrome/Chromium | — |
| pdf | `pptx-convert` | PDF from the PPTX via PowerPoint or LibreOffice | — | ✅ | — | identical | Microsoft PowerPoint (macOS) or LibreOffice | uses your installed office suite | — |
| png | `pptx-convert` | PNG previews rendered from PPTX by Office | — | ✅ | — | identical | PowerPoint or LibreOffice, plus Poppler (pdftoppm) | uses your installed office suite and Poppler | — |
| pptx | `artifact-tool` | PowerPoint via the Codex artifact-tool runtime | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | native | Codex runtime (@oai/artifact-tool ≥ 2.7.3) | Proprietary (OpenAI) — internal evaluation and testing only; never bundled | — |

## How `auto` resolves

0. **Preference** — `SLIDECRAFT_PPTX_ENGINE` / `SLIDECRAFT_PDF_ENGINE` when set and available.
1. **PPTX** — `pptxgenjs` in every agent, including Codex; `artifact-tool` requires an explicit local evaluation choice. Default: `pptxgenjs`.
2. **PDF** — `html` when the theme prefers HTML (`prefers: html`) and Chrome is installed; otherwise `native`.
3. **PNG** — `resvg`. **HTML** — `html`.

Fidelity levels: **native** = real PowerPoint objects; **identical** = rendered by PowerPoint/LibreOffice itself; **same-layout** = identical geometry and line breaks, drawn with the bundled metric-compatible fonts; **preview** = raster thumbnails.

`@oai/artifact-tool` is proprietary (OpenAI, internal evaluation and testing only). SlideCraft never bundles it; the adapter calls a copy already installed with Codex.
